source_record.description:
Lexroom is building the AI platform where legal work gets done. In just over two years, we've grown from zero to €25M ARR, and today more than 20,000 legal professionals across Italy, Spain, Germany, France, and Bulgaria rely on Lexroom.

We're backed by $73M from Left Lane Capital, Base10 Partners, and Eurazeo, and we're a team of around 300 builders who move fast, say things straight, and own each outcome.

Our next goal? Become Europe's most-used legal product.

 

Why Lexroom?

  • Shape the Standard: Be part of the team setting the benchmark for legal AI in Europe.

  • Work with the Best: Collaborate with exceptional colleagues in a culture that values competence, curiosity, and ambition.

  • Deliver Meaningful Results: Your work will directly influence how legal professionals operate—faster, clearer, and more efficiently.

At Lexroom, we leave buzzwords behind. Here, you’ll build something that lasts: a trusted platform, a strong reputation, a new standard for the legal world.

 

The Role

Lexroom is building its partnership channel and wants it to become a material driver of revenue growth. As Partnership Lead, you will own that channel in your local market (Germany): sourcing, activating and growing relationships with consulting firms and system integrators, supporting co-sell on large enterprise accounts, and contributing to early product partnerships as our API surface develops.

You will turn the partnership strategy into signed agreements and partner-sourced pipeline. This is a hands-on role with high ownership and a direct line to commercial leadership.

Your key responsibilities

  • Partner sourcing and activation: identify, qualify and onboard consulting firms, system integrators and enterprise partners, taking them from first contact to signed agreement.

  • Relationship ownership: manage a portfolio of strategic partners day to day, running joint account planning and co-sell motions with Sales.

  • Deal execution: negotiate co-sell and revenue-share agreements within the commercial framework, working with Finance and Legal on terms.

  • Playbook execution: apply and refine processes for partner qualification, engagement rules and co-sell, documenting what works so it can be repeated.

  • Partner enablement: deliver training, certification and co-marketing materials so partners can position and sell Lexroom independently.

  • Tooling and attribution: keep partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline accurate in the CRM and apply the deal registration policy consistently.

  • Performance tracking: report on KPIs (pipeline generated, ARR sourced or influenced, partners activated) and prepare quarterly business reviews with key partners.

  • Cross-functional alignment: coordinate lead handoff with Sales, and share partner feedback with Product on integration and API opportunities.

What we're looking for

  • Partnership track record: 4+ years in business development, alliances or channel roles in B2B SaaS, including hands-on experience managing revenue-accountable relationships with system integrators, consulting firms or enterprise partners.

  • Standing and network: a strong professional network in your local market and the credibility to open doors at senior level with consulting firms, system integrators and large enterprises.

  • Deal negotiation: experience closing partner or co-sell agreements in multi-stakeholder, long-cycle sales. Familiarity with MEDDICC or Challenger Sale is a plus.

  • Builder mindset: comfortable working in an early-stage function where processes are still being defined, and contributing to building them.

  • Commercial and analytical rigour: able to track and forecast partner-sourced pipeline, and to prioritise partners and deals based on data.

  • Languages: fluent English and native or professional fluency in the local language.

  • Nice to have: a legal background and/or an established network in the local legal market.

Rewarding your contribution

  • Compensation: €145,000 OTE (€100,000 base + €45,000 variable)

  • Equity: meaningful equity on top, in line with the seniority of the role

  • Team retreats & off-sites: dedicated time to connect, collaborate and spark bold ideas

At Lexroom, ambition meets discipline and purpose. We’re not just building a product—we’re setting a new standard for the legal world. If you’re ready to contribute to something lasting and meaningful, we’d love to hear from you.

Compensation: €100K – €145K • Offers Equity
